newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Freak storm kills 11 in Ukraine and Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Freak storm kills 11 in Ukraine and Belarus.

text.p: Eleven people were killed in Ukraine and Belarus in a fierce summer storm that felled trees, ripped off roofs and tore down power lines, officials in the two former Soviet republics said on Tuesday.
"Eight people died and 32 were injured in western Ukraine late on Monday because of high winds and heavy rains," Natalya Tsushko of the emergencies ministry press service told Reuters.
The storm then wove a path of destruction north to neighbouring Belarus, where a civil defence spokesman said three people were killed near the capital, Minsk.
In Ukraine, some 850 towns and villages were left without electricity and hundreds of coal miners were rescued after spending the night underground because of power cuts.
Some people were killed after hiding under trees which then fell on them, while others were electrocuted by live power lines, Tsushko said.
Crews were checking what area of spring crops had been damaged, officials said.
